meta.name: bigquery
meta.description: Instructions for querying Google BigQuery using the bq command-line tool. Useful for running SQL queries, exploring datasets, and exporting results.

copy.tagline: 用SQL查询BigQuery数据集并导出结果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用BigQuery做数据分析或报表
copy.tagline_en: Query BigQuery datasets with SQL and export results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use BigQuery for data analysis or reporting

howto.what: Claude 可以用 bq 命令行工具查询 Google BigQuery，包括列出数据集和表、运行 SQL 查询、预览数据、导出结果到 CSV 等。
howto.when: 当你要求查询 BigQuery 数据、探索数据集或导出查询结果时触发。

say.text: 列出当前项目中的所有数据集。
运行 SQL 查询并返回前 10 行。
将查询结果导出为 CSV 文件。

howto.what_en: Claude can query Google BigQuery using the bq command-line tool, including listing datasets and tables, running SQL queries, previewing data, and exporting results to CSV.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to query BigQuery data, explore datasets, or export query results.

say_en.text: List all datasets in the current project.
Run a SQL query and return the first 10 rows.
Export query results to a CSV file.
